_notes: Every path through one ported conversation script (one file per script: talks-NAME.json, NAME the script's folder in src/uqm/comm), recorded by running UQM's own script with UQM's commglue.c, sis.c and string tables, and the rest of the talk engine stubbed (tools/extract/golden/comm.c says what each event is). Each start is a story state (fields not given are 0), a flagship (crew, fuel in 1/100 units, landers, resource units, element amounts, module slots, the drive and jet slots with a thruster or jets, captain's and ship's names), the date (a new game's where not given), the seed of the scripts' random numbers (TFB_SeedRandom; 12345 where not given), the races' standings where not a new game's (alliances: good, bad or dead), the races' spheres where not a new game's (fleets: each race's actual and known strength, which StartSphereTracking reads and sets; a new game's are its ships' strengths, unknown), the escort fleet's worth and room for more ships (escorts; none where not given), its ships' races in built_ship_q's order (escort_fleet, which CountEscortShips, RemoveEscortShips and GetHeadLink read; none where not given), the bio data aboard (bio: TotalBioMass; 0 where not given), where the talk is (activity: LOBYTE (GLOBAL (CurrentActivity)), SUPER_MELEE where not given) and the system's own group met (battle_group: the field of the offset BattleGroupRef holds; 0 where not given; the Ur-Quan's and the Kohr-Ah's starts have URQUAN_PROBE_GRPOFFS0, COLONY_GRPOFFS0 and SAMATRA_GRPOFFS0 set to 0x1100, 0x2200 and 0x3300), and its steps: the replies chosen from the start, each the place in the replies offered, and the events after the last of them up to the next replies offered or the talk's end. An offer marked seen reaches a talk state already walked from this start, so the walk goes no further; a start with follow walks only the replies calling those functions, and one with prefix starts its walk after those replies (the rest is walked from other starts). Surrendering to the Ur-Quan (setSegue (Segue_defeat)) sets the crew to (COUNT)~0, 65535, as UQM marks the game lost. Voices are off (usingSpeech false); selling minerals runs as if a button were pressed at once.

Texts are content (CC BY-NC-SA 2.5), so only the first 16 hex digits of each line's SHA-256 are here; set names the field written (data/game-state.json); offer gives each reply's phrase number, the script's function it calls and its text's hash; a line's callback (NPCPhrase_cb) and a callback's run name the script's function.
